answer: A hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The reef counter is kept in canyon and quill exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 19 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
